title: Van der Waerden number W(6,3), lower bound
statement: Colour n consecutive integers with 6 colours so that no colour holds an arithmetic progression of 3 terms, with n as large as possible; it shows W(6,3) > n. The best known lower bound is W(6,3) >= 226, by Blankenship, Cummings and Taranchuk (2018), so such a colouring of 225 integers is known and one of 226 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of the n integers in order, digits 0..5 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the number of integers coloured; it proves W(6,3) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: W(6,3) >= 226: Blankenship, Cummings and Taranchuk (2018), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
